analyzer: h1+h2+h3 rubric scoring (agent judgment on collected evidence + measured k6 load + JFR profile under the h2 load window)

testDepth.note: 3 test files incl. a Testcontainers-backed ProductControllerIT (87 LOC) and a service test (71 LOC). Assertion census shows 1 grep-visible assertion — tests use WebTestClient expectBody chains the census regex does not count (collector limitation); still a thin suite in absolute terms.

layering.note: controller / service(+impl) / repository / request-response DTOs / redis / exception / config separation; no logic in entities.

frameworkFit.note: Full reactive stack (WebFlux + R2DBC + reactive Redis) used end to end — coherent, matches an I/O-bound profile.

structuralSanity.note: No god classes (max 47 LOC main); violation: hardcoded DB password in application.yaml.

riskBloat.note: Unused-declared flags on Boot starters are known dependency:analyze false positives; r2dbc-postgresql uses an old-style 1.1.2.RELEASE versioning line.

boots.note: Boots in the docker envelope and serves the full 10s+60s load at both profiles: 0% failed requests, checks 100%.

latencyThroughput.note: PASS at both profiles: p95 227ms / 1448 rps @200 VUs with the tightest tail of the set (max 382ms); p95 80ms @50 VUs.

jfrProfile.note: Clean request path: 4 monitor events, 40 ThreadParks (idle-pool), no request-path socket reads (Redis hits are sub-ms); GC p99 87ms envelope-normal. Tightest tail in the set matches the clean profile.

legibility.note: Small, consistent, readable; nonstandard capitalized package segment (com.MSyamsandiYW).

hygiene.note: Two violations: no license file, and a hardcoded DB password in application.yaml (+ docker-compose defaults).
